reference.scope: S2-47: actual v1 surface-QI and v2/v3/v7 CreateDevice routes carry their creation version before initialization. COLORKEYENABLE is true only for v1; SPECULARENABLE only for v2; NORMALIZENORMALS for v1-v3. Actual initialization and initial sync are tested with non-relevant geometry/material stubs. Initial sync uses the valid Device7 state namespace, preserves SELECTARG1(TEXTURE)/CURRENT and clears zero defaults when reusing the owner host device. Legacy MODULATE alpha selects TEXTURE for ARGB/unbound and CURRENT for RGB; SetTexture recomputes it. Changed legacy stage state opts out; same stage/map values preserve mode; changed map reactivates it. Legacy LIGHTING/LOCALVIEWER/NORMALIZENORMALS return FFFFFFFF and ignore writes while modern getters retain underlying defaults. Modern TEXTUREMAPBLEND rejection/redundant-call behavior is retained. Native actual C verifies 128 RGB/ARGB/unbound cycles, public holds, binding rollback and accepted texture-prefix/alpha-emission retry, plus 170+1052 retained native observations and 20 strict-compiled runtime mutations. XP uses the replacement DLL and Device3/7 views for state and texture calls, not original Microsoft HAL. Sixteen 8x8 ARGB target quads produce actual guest readback commands; CPU replies are simulated, GPU replay independently checks all 1024 RGBA pixels. No fresh Present/game/FPS coverage, general state-block legacy-mode metadata semantics across mixed interfaces, arbitrary formats/Reset/thread/device loss, S2-53 or full review stages 4/5/6 completion. D3D8/9, host/protocol ABI, shaders and bundle are unchanged.

validationRepairs: The expanded native harness uses SDK enums and the real initialization/sync/render emitter. Non-relevant matrix/material/clip helpers and host emissions are stubbed. Strict compilation caught a duplicate ZBIAS constant and missing SDK antialias enum; test scaffolding was corrected.

The previous-source control uses the previous device/legacy frontend and current shared cascade header; it strictly compiles then fails the actual versioned-default assertion. This is not a full previous-bundle control.

The SDK program uses IDirect3DTexture2 for actual Device3 texture calls; a strict SDK type error was fixed before XP execution. Creation is exercised through each actual versioned entry, while state/texture/render inspection uses shared Device3/7 views.
CPU XP readback responses are simulated; sixteen actual GPU readback responses and all 1024 RGBA pixels are independently validated on each backend.
